label: Bible Study
prompt: And as Moses lifted up the _____ in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
verse: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
note: Jesus points Nicodemus back to Numbers 21 — the brass serpent lifted up for healing.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of _____: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
verse: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
note: 'Prisoners of hope' — Zechariah's lovely name for people held fast by God's promises, with double to come.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And I will shoot three _____ on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
verse: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
note: Jonathan's secret signal for David hiding in the field: where the arrows landed would tell him whether to run.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For we must all appear before the _____ seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
verse: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
note: Paul once stood before Gallio's judgment seat in Corinth itself (Acts 18) — his readers knew the picture.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: _____ silver shall men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.
verse: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.
note: Jeremiah's refining image ends grimly: silver that won't purify is 'reprobate silver,' because the LORD hath rejected it.
